meaning:
κλύδων, -ωνος, ὁ
(κλύζω, of the sea, to wash over), [in LXX: Jon.1.4; Jon.1.12 (סַעַר), al. ;]
a billow, surge: Luk.8:24, Jas.1:6.†
SYN.: κῦμα, a wave (AS)

elsewhere.note: They came to him, and awoke him, saying, “Master, master, we are dying!” He awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water, and they ceased, and it…
But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
